review.title: Three community descriptors: complete native ambiguity with source limits retained
review.independence_basis: Authored partial database/provenance assessment. Parent independently read the three source contexts, complete native alternatives, unchanged scientific scope and local candidates, then compared and rehashed every final M5 candidate/receipt before approving application. Shared source binder, guarded engine, gate wrapper and builder were separately reviewed. This is not independent full scientific approval.
review.summary: Four existing descriptors across three communities now retain AMBIGUOUS and every native candidate: two Bacillus species descriptors, the Pseudoclavibacter genus descriptor and the At-RSPHERE P. brassicacearum descriptor. No alternative is selected as an exact study-stock identity. Actual guarded M5 applications, three native sidecars and 24 required native commands are bound; all other canonical biology and old history remain unchanged.
review.scope_description: Only the declared GTDB statuses/complete candidate sets, their source and rank boundaries, actual applications, native history and scoped command receipts. No whole-record scientific reassessment.
review.selection: Three whole records, CommunityMech:000373, CommunityMech:000365 and CommunityMech:000003, explicitly selected from the previously reviewed four-record source plan after the 000401 shared status-only canary completed application, eight checks, immutable save, exact input audit and complete M5 checkpoint. The three native plans and M5 stages were inspected before actual serial application.
limitations: Partial technical/provenance review with scientific_review:false. No whole-record scientific approval, corpus QC completion, reference-snippet pass or release clearance is asserted.

Candidate sets describe the existing NCBI descriptors in one exact pinned crosswalk. They do not independently identify any study-stock assembly, quantify candidate probabilities or establish a support-genome denominator.

The 000373 source inspection uses retained selected Methods/Results/Discussion passages, not a certified complete supplement/genome audit. Reported G12/Y4 stock names remain unchanged; mechanism, colonization, fitness and persistence limitations are not cleared.

The 000365 source is abstract-only. Exact stocks, complete membership, the 86-percent denominator and detailed cultivation remain unresolved. Genus-level alternatives must not be interpreted as selected species or a stock roster.

For 000003 the source's Root401/R401 challenge context does not establish a single commensal roster. Existing issue 1251, the inherited host entry and umbrella/assay population concerns remain unresolved. No host migration, strain alias or membership correction was made.

Existing X25 and C. kluyveri blocks, and every other descriptor/block in 000003, remain exact. Their source releases, populations and stock placement are not newly certified by this status-only correction.

Local and M5 binders retain their distinct revision and NCBI database-stat observations; matching label/rank queries do not establish a whole-database checksum or release. The crosswalk, source caches, native resolver, authored contexts and all captured review inputs are individually hash-bound.

All 24 required commands passed, including native history creation and seven validators per record. Historical successor admission, generated products, final combined full QC and separate reference comparison remain separately accounted work. Existing scientific ledgers remain immutable.

records.label: Complete G12/Y4 descriptor alternatives, unchanged reported stocks and X25

evidence.locator: Retained PMID42388034/PMC13569317 Methods, line13; exact source anchors in authored context and source metadata primary_locators
evidence.summary: Methods names G12 as B. amyloliquefaciens, Y4 as B. pumilus and X25 as B. velezensis based on previous studies; G12 is rhizosphere-derived and Y4/X25 are endophytes. This supports retaining reported identities and experimental context, not a new exact-stock genome assignment.
The pinned native species-name routes yield two alternatives for NCBITaxon:1390 and four for NCBITaxon:1408, preserved in native order with no selected candidate or invented denominator.

Actual guarded application persisted precisely the reviewed M5 candidate: two statuses, complete2/4 candidate sets and one native event; every other scientific field and prior history remains unchanged.

records.label: Complete Pseudoclavibacter genus alternatives without invented stocks

evidence.locator: Retained PMID42442429 abstract, dominant-prokaryote sentence lines36–37
evidence.summary: The abstract names Pseudoclavibacter among dominant prokaryotes but supplies no exact strain or complete species roster. Only that genus-level source scope is used here.
The native ncbi_rank_g correspondence for NCBITaxon255204 has four complete Pseudoclavibacter genus alternatives, retained in native order without a selected species or stock.
The actual M5 application changed only one status, four candidate identifiers and one native event. The existing C. kluyveri five-genome block and all scientific content remain unchanged.

records.label: Complete P. brassicacearum descriptor alternatives with roster concerns retained

evidence.locator: Retained PMID40663585/PMC12262851 main text, Introduction/Results in flattened line94; exact R401 anchor retained in source metadata
evidence.summary: The paper describes opportunistic P. brassicacearum Root401/R401 as a challenge stock and distinguishes it from commensal SynCom members. This establishes source context, not correctness of the inherited umbrella roster.
The native species-name route for NCBITaxon930166 yields Pseudomonas_E brassicacearum and Pseudomonas_E neoaurantiaca. Both are retained without selecting an exact-stock identity.

Actual guarded M5 replacement changed only taxonomy[2]'s status, two alternatives and one native event. The missing strain designation, pre-existing host entry, other descriptors/blocks and all scientific text remain unchanged.
